description: A PHP source file for the second step of a Web UI wizard that configures Wi-Fi networks on a gateway device. It includes initialization, validation, and UI logic for managing Wi-Fi SSIDs, security modes, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends Wi-Fi configuration data via AJAX to a server-side handler to apply changes.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string to prevent injection issues.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Gathers form data, constructs configuration JSON, and initiates save operation via AJAX.
